name: comm_by_moves
statement: circ a b = circ b a
why: Commutativity: the rectangle flipped on its diagonal is the same rectangle.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y. The circle operation: every ⊕ opens into a product of rods, a box with its unit attached.
Swap: reflect across the diagonal (CommSemiring.mul_comm).

name: assoc_by_moves
statement: circ (circ a b) c = circ a (circ b c)
why: Associativity: slabs and columns are one box.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y. The circle operation: every ⊕ opens into a product of rods, a box with its unit attached.
Regroup: re-cut the same box (Semiring.mul_assoc).

name: zero_by_moves
why: Identity: a side of length 0 flattens the rectangle to a strip.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y. The circle operation: every ⊕ opens into a product of rods, a box with its unit attached.
Collapse: zero lengths and units fall away.

name: mpow_add_by_moves
statement: mpow a (m + n) = circ (mpow a m) (mpow a n)
why: A cube of m + n sides is a cube of m sides times a cube of n.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y.
The circle operation: every ⊕ opens into a product of rods, a box with its unit attached.
Flatten: powers add (pow_add').

name: wcomm_by_moves
statement: k · circK k a b = k · circK k b a
why: Dial: scale the weighted corner into a plain box, then flip it.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Dial: k times a k-weighted corner is the plain box on k·a and k·b (circK_scale).
Dial: k times a k-weighted corner is the plain box on k·a and k·b (circK_scale).

name: fexp_iter_by_moves
statement: fexp a (b + 1) = circ a (fexp a b)
why: Rung 2 on whole numbers: one more slab extrudes the fused power.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y.
Extrude: rung n+1 is rung n with one more slab (fexp_iter).

name: inv_by_moves
why: Inverse in a field: squash the second side to 1/(1+u); the rectangle has area 1.

frames.caption: The goal, as the engine reads it.
Lift: x ↦ 1+x attaches the unit to both sides. Safe because 1+x = 1+y gives x = y. The circle operation: every ⊕ opens into a product of rods, a box with its unit attached.
Squash: (1+u) times 1/(1+u) is 1 (inv_one_add, mul_inv_cancel).
Collapse: zero lengths and units fall away.
